tagline: Your Trusted Partner in Life Insurance & Real Estate
profilePictureAlt: Flor Arcilla, licensed insurance agent and real estate sales associate
bio: From real estate to financial services, I have spent years helping families and investors across Cavite and beyond make decisions they feel confident about. Whether that is finding the right home, growing their wealth, or protecting what they have built, I am here to guide you every step of the way. With ProFriends properties in Cavite and PRULife UK insurance solutions, I offer guidance that covers both sides of your financial life, so you do not have to figure it out alone.
richTextAbout:
I started my career in real estate, helping buyers, sellers, and investors make confident decisions in any market. From there, I expanded into financial services, helping families protect their income, health, and future.


My combined experience means I can see your situation through two lenses at once: what you need to protect today, and how your property can work harder for your tomorrow.


Outside the office, I enjoy mentoring newly licensed agents and fostering the next generation of talent in our industry. When I'm not doing that, you'll likely find me out for a casual walk or run!
licences: Licensed Insurance Agent Since 2020, PRULife UK License #70111974

servicesPageHero.heading:
Protect What Matters.
Own What You Deserve.
servicesPageHero.subCopy: Whether you're here or abroad, I will help you protect your family and own your dream home with the right plan, the right property, and a trusted partner by your side.

services.title: Traditional Insurance
services.imageAlt: Traditional life insurance plans for long-term protection
services.description: Protect the people who matter most with plans designed for solid, reliable coverage. PRULife Your Term gives you affordable yearly renewable protection with optional add-ons, PRUTerm 15 offers straightforward 15-year coverage, PRULove for Life provides lifetime security with limited premium payments, and PRULifetime Income guarantees a 5% annual payout for life. Whatever stage you are in, there is a plan built for you.
services.tags: PRULife Your Term, PRUTerm 15, PRULove for Life, PRULifetime Income, Term Life, Whole Life, Endowment

services.title: Insurance With Investment
services.imageAlt: Variable unit-linked insurance plans for protection and wealth growth
services.description: Why choose between protection and growing your wealth? PRULife UK's variable unit-linked (VUL) plans split your premium between life coverage and investment funds tied to the PRULink fund range. Whether you prefer regular contributions through PRULink Assurance Account Plus, a single-pay strategy with PRULink Investor Account Plus, or a shorter two-year commitment with PRUMillion Protect, there is a plan aligned to your financial goals and timeline.
services.tags: PRULink Assurance Account Plus, PRULink Investor Account Plus, PRUMillion Protect, VUL, PRULink Funds, Wealth Growth

services.title: Health Insurance
services.imageAlt: Health and critical illness insurance coverage for individuals and families
services.description: Stay financially protected against the high cost of hospitalization and serious illness. PRUShield provides affordable daily hospital income coverage for injuries and illnesses, while PRUHealth FamLove lets you share critical illness protection across up to three family members. PRUHealth Prime specifically targets all forms of cancer. Focus on getting better — not on the bills.
services.tags: PRUShield, PRUHealth FamLove, PRUHealth Prime, Critical Illness, Hospitalization, Cancer Cover, Family Plan

services.title: Accident Protection
services.description: Accidents are unpredictable — but their financial impact does not have to be. Personal accident riders available under PRULife UK plans cover accidental death, disablement, dismemberment, and medical expenses. Easy to attach to an existing policy, these benefits give you and your family an added layer of security for life's unexpected moments.
services.tags: Personal Accident, ADD Rider, Accidental Death, Disablement, Medical Expense Reimbursement

services.title: Pre-Selling Properties
services.imageAlt: Scale model of a pre-selling ProFriends property in Cavite
services.description: Get in early and lock in the best price before a property is built. ProFriends' pre-selling units in Cavite — including new phases at Lancaster New City in Imus and General Trias, and Westwind condominiums — offer lower introductory rates, flexible payment terms, and strong appreciation potential as these townships continue to grow. I guide you through unit selection, reservations, and the full buying process from day one.
services.tags: Pre-Selling, Lancaster New City, Westwind, Flexible Terms, Low Down Payment

services.title: Ready For Occupancy (RFO)
services.imageAlt: Move-in ready ProFriends house and lot in Cavite
services.description: Want to move in right away? ProFriends has RFO house and lot units available across Lancaster New City, Micara Estates in Tanza, and Minami Residences in Cavite — fully built and ready for turnover with no waiting. I help you find the right unit that matches your budget, lifestyle, and location so you can start your next chapter without delay.
services.tags: RFO, Lancaster New City, Micara Estates, Minami Residences, Move-In Ready, House and Lot

services.title: Home Buying Assistance
services.imageAlt: Happy couple receiving keys to their new ProFriends home in Cavite
services.description: Buying your first home — or your next one — is a big deal, and you should not have to figure it out alone. From finding the right ProFriends property in Cavite to computing your monthly amortization, processing Pag-IBIG or bank financing, and handling all the paperwork, I walk you through every step so you can make a confident, informed decision.
services.tags: First Home, Pag-IBIG, Bank Financing, In-House Financing, Full Assistance, Cavite

services.title: Property Investment
services.imageAlt: ProFriends township development in Cavite as a property investment
services.description: Cavite is one of the fastest-growing provinces in the Philippines, and ProFriends is at the center of it. With integrated townships like Lancaster New City spanning Imus and General Trias, and condominium villages like Westwind and Lamore at Micara Estates offering strong rental potential, now is a great time to buy and hold or earn passive income. I help you identify the right property and financing strategy for your goals.
services.tags: Lancaster New City, Westwind, Lamore, Township, Rental Income, Buy and Hold, Cavite

services.title: Condo Villages
services.imageAlt: Modern condominium village in Cavite by ProFriends
services.description: ProFriends is bringing modern vertical living to Cavite with two condo villages — Westwind at Lancaster New City in General Trias, and Lamore at Micara Estates in Tanza. Ideal for young professionals, OFWs, small families, and investors, these communities offer studio to three-bedroom units with resort-style amenities, accessible via CAVITEX and CALAX.
services.tags: Westwind, Lamore, Condo, General Trias, Tanza, CAVITEX, OFW, Studio to 3BR

services.title: OFW Property Assistance
services.description: Living or working abroad doesn't have to stop you from investing back home. I specialize in helping OFWs secure their dream property remotely - from virtual tripping and online reservations to processing Pag-IBIG OFW loans and coordinating with family representatives here in the Philippines.
services.tags: OFW, Remote Buying, Pag-IBIG OFW, Virtual Tour

services.title: Financing & Loan Assistance
services.description: Not sure which payment scheme works best for you? I help you explore and compare all available options - Pag-IBIG Fund (HDMF), bank financing, or in-house installment plans. I assist with documentary requirements, loan applications, and computations so the financial side of your purchase is as smooth as possible.
services.tags: Pag-IBIG, Bank Loan, In-House, Loan Computation

services.title: Property Tripping
services.description: See it before you sign it. I arrange on-site and virtual property tours so you can experience the community, check the actual unit or lot, and feel confident in your decision. From Lancaster New City in Cavite to ProFriends' Iloilo projects, I coordinate tours around your schedule - even on weekends.
services.tags: Virtual Tour, On-Site Visit, No Pressure, Weekends OK

services.title: After-Sales Support
services.description: My job doesn't end at the sale. I continue to assist you with post-purchase needs - from following up on turnover schedules and title transfers, to coordinating with ProFriends' property management for repairs, community concerns, and account updates through the buyer's portal.
services.tags: Post-Purchase, Turnover, Title Transfer, ProFriends Portal

testimonials.name: Anonymous 1
testimonials.text: Flor helped us buy our first home and set up life insurance in the same month. Having one trusted professional coordinate both saved us so much stress. She anticipated every question before we even thought to ask it.

testimonials.name: Anonymous 2
testimonials.text: I came to Flor purely for investment property advice. She not only found me a fantastic property below asking price, but flagged that my existing policy had a major coverage gap. Saved me thousands twice over.

testimonials.name: Anonymous 3
testimonials.text: After my divorce I needed to restructure everything - health plan, life cover, and selling the family home. Flor handled it all with empathy and professionalism. I never felt like just a transaction.

testimonials.name: Anonymous 4
testimonials.text: Very knowledgeable on both the real estate and insurance sides. Flor helped us sell our condo and roll the proceeds into a new whole-life policy as part of our retirement plan. Responsive and thorough.

testimonials.name: Anonymous 5
testimonials.text: I was relocating from out of state and felt completely overwhelmed. Flor sent me a personalised neighbourhood comparison and had my home insurance quote ready on closing day. Incredible service.

testimonials.name: Anonymous 6
testimonials.text: Flor helped our small business get group health coverage for six employees at a price we could actually afford. Clear, honest, no pressure. We have already referred three colleagues.
